published_ranges._notes: Made from SABIC ULTEM 9085 resin. Density 1.34 g/cm3 is from the SABIC resin TDS that Push Plastic hosts, not a filament test. Must be dried before printing. Nozzle range is above the 300C hotend limit of Bambu X1/P1/P2S; only its 350C lower bound is reachable on a 350C hotend - effectively not printable on Bambu printers. No Bambu Studio PEI preset; bambu_parent omitted.
